title: AI Gateway – Elevated errors for Gemini 4 models using Unified Billing
summary: Cloudflare is investigating elevated errors affecting AI Gateway requests to Gemini 4 models (gemini-4-argon, gemini-4-carbon, gemini-4-hydrogen, gemini-4-neon) routed through Google Vertex AI with Unified Billing. We are working to understand the full impact and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
